questions.q: An accelerating train (acceleration $a=1 \mathrm{~m} \cdot \mathrm{~s}^{-2}$ ) of $n$ blocks have a mass distribution as shown in the figure. The rightmost block of mass $n M$ is the engine. The blocks are connected through a Aluminum cable of cross-section $10 \mathrm{~cm}^2$. The maximum allowed strain in the connecting cables is 0.001 . Taking $M=1000 \mathrm{~kg}$ and Young's modulus of Aluminum to be $7 \times 10^{10} \mathrm{~Pa}$, the correct choice(s) is(are).
options: all connecting cables will have equal strain.
the difference of stress in any two consecutive cables is in arithmetic progression.
the train can have at most 12 blocks.
the maximum stress is between blocks having masses $M$ and $2 M$.

questions.q: A spherical raindrop of initial mass $M_0$ and initial radius $R$ falls freely from rest. Let $\rho$ be the constant density and $r$ the radius at time $t$. Assume that the drop maintains it's spherical shape. The drop loses mass at the rate $d m / d t=-4 \pi k \rho r^2$. where $k$ is a constant. Define $t_c=\frac{R}{k}$. Select the correct statement(s)
options: The speed of the drop at time $t_c / 2$ is $15 g R / 8 k$
The rate of mass loss goes to zero as time $t \rightarrow t_c$
The drop loses all it's mass in time $t_c$
The momentum approaches $M_0 g R / 4 k$ as $t \rightarrow t_c$

questions.q: The coefficient of static friction between a small block and the surface of a horizontal turntable is 0.09 . The block is placed at a distance of 0.1 m from the centre of the turntable. At time $t=0$ s the turntable starts rotating from rest with a constant angular acceleration of $0.5 \mathrm{rad} \cdot \mathrm{s}^{-2}$. The time at which the block starts sliding is $t_s$. Select the correct statement(s).
options: The angle between the net linear acceleration and radial vector is $\pi / 4$ radians.
$t_s$ is 6 s
At $t_s$ the angular speed of the turntable is $6 \mathrm{rad} \cdot \mathrm{s}^{-1}$.
The turntable has rotated through 9 radians.
